info.description:
Purolator REST API requests, generated from the PHP scripts in PHP_Puro (tools/build_collection.php).

430 requests, each verified live against the Purolator Certification environment. Host: https://shipapi.purolator.com (scope portal_api).

Create a Postman environment with REST_ClientId, REST_Secret, REST_XApiKey, AccountNumber and Different_AccountNumber, run 00 - Auth first to fill REST_Token, then run each folder top to bottom. No credentials are stored here.
